author: delegate-eval
title: Make playwright reports private
body:
## Why

The Playwright report bucket is still public read, and the traces it holds can
contain request bodies from the dashboard's own test runs. Make it private,
drop the CORS rule the browser no longer needs, and expire traces after a week
instead of thirty days.

Plan: docs/example-log-retention.md
Step: 1

plan.text:
# Review worker log retention

> **Status: approved.** One step. A step PR implements the plan and does not
> edit this document.

## Why

The `/aws/ecs/delegate` log group holds thirty days of agent runs. That is
enough to read a re-review back after a PR has been idle over a long weekend,
but not enough for the monthly cost read: the workflow phase metrics are derived
from those logs, so a slow leak in one phase is invisible past day 30.

## Step 1

Change the retention of the `/aws/ecs/delegate` log group in
`deploy/components/worker.ts` from 30 days to 90 days.

That is the whole step: the log group name, the metric filters, the task
definition, the ECS cluster and the execution role are unchanged.

## Out of scope

- The Playwright reports bucket, which belongs to a different plan.
- Retention on any other log group.
- The deploy role's `logs:*` permissions, which already allow `PutLogEvents`
  and nothing that reads.
